results.title: Boundary scenario: prompt hits exact max_input_tokens limit n

input_facts.prompt_text: Summarize this curriculum reading passage at the exact 100-token context limit.

trace: R1 skipped: all required facts present
results.worked_trace: R1 (missing info): False (all 6 required facts present); R2 (token boundary): True (estimated_tokens 100 >= max_input_tokens 100) -> chunk_prompt_at_token_limit.
results.rationale: Lesson 01 explains that an LLM accepts n tokens and predicts output tokens one by one in an expanding window, which can stop mid-sentence near the limit. Because estimated_tokens (100) equals max_input_tokens (100), zero window capacity remains for generated output tokens, so the teacher prompt must be chunked or shortened first.

With prompt_text empty and estimated_tokens and human_review_enabled omitted, the startup workflow cannot check token limits or governance safeguards and must request missing facts.
